notes.en: Qualified the 1.1.0 restoration-r2 package with its exact shipped archive through real App tool dispatch: the real Linux/riscv64 guest (kernel 6.18.56, Node v20.19.2, Python 3.13.5) ran the bundled python3-stdlib generator and the bundled prng_parity.js cross-check — the Python/Node PRNG streams matched byte-for-byte, and three canonical digest comparisons (flowfield, orbitwash and overrides) passed, four regenerated artifacts were byte-identical across repeated runs, and the negative-parameter probe exited 2 honestly. Native WebKit on iPadOS 27 Simulator then held the viewer contract at strict zero tolerance: the actual seed navigation (next/prev via browser.click) and the restored digest equalled the initial digest with no tolerance, the restored resample reproduced identical RGBA bytes, the canvas digest stayed unchanged after clicking Download PNG, and the next-seed frame honestly differed; the raw captures were independently decoded to confirm initial==restored==restored-resample RGBA bytes with next different. Delivery: browser.exportFile committed the 1200x1200 PNG (858,996 bytes, SHA-256 ccad8c49827d958dda126979a3f88e9e081a0970836e0795507345bdf276e0c7); those exact bytes were re-proved inside the guest by the pinned sibling stdlib PNG verifier (QA-only independent validation — this package ships no verifier, and the reuse adds no public runtime dependency, triggers no automatic sibling installation and inherits no permissions) with a full chunk-CRC walk, full IDAT inflate of 5,761,200 bytes, size and digest checks; workspace.publishOutput froze them into the run-owned output snapshot, byte-equal on independent after-teardown read-back; the delivered PNG, the five diagnostic captures and the native-export, guest-verify and publish receipts were retained before workspace cleanup. One qualification test passed, none failed or was skipped (197.362 seconds), zero paid model calls. The only archive member changed versus the prior candidate that failed actual native read-back is assets/viewer-ui.js (SHA-256 c23a5794472de25b09c8f6be241b06c49b10b126c554e5a672b6f890c389e564), whose 2D context request now declares willReadFrequently; no postprocessing, tolerance, assertion or numeric golden was weakened. This review binds these exact archive bytes and the package's full declared grant surface — 12 registered tools and 5 capabilities — and the executed proof chain covers exec.shell, exec.localService, browser navigate/observe/screenshot/click, browser.exportFile and workspace.publishOutput; the declared jobs.* tools are bound as registered surface, not separately exercised. This is guest plus Simulator native qualification from a private 302-derived qualification source: browser.exportFile is not yet part of any public App release, so App availability awaits mainline integration and the mainline-owned minimumAppVersion decision — the catalog App compatibility floor is an external gate still PENDING and nothing here claims a first-capable version. Not physical-device or Apple-published-build acceptance. iOS channel only; no Android native evidence. No paid model call was made. Review approval of this package and its rights is separate from catalog admission; no download offer is made.
notes.zh-Hans: 1.1.0 restoration-r2包已连同其确切随附归档，通过真实App工具调度完成鉴定：真实Linux/riscv64客体（内核6.18.56、Node v20.19.2、Python 3.13.5）运行随附python3标准库生成器与随附prng_parity.js交叉校验——Python/Node PRNG流逐字节一致，三项规范摘要对照（flowfield、orbitwash及覆盖参数）均通过，四份再生成产物跨重复运行逐字节一致，负参数探测以退出码2如实失败。iPadOS 27模拟器下的原生WebKit在严格零容差下保持查看器契约：真实种子导航（browser.click下一/上一）与恢复摘要等于初始摘要且无容差，恢复重采样复现完全相同的RGBA字节，点击 Download PNG 后画布摘要保持不变，下一种子画面如实不同；原始捕获经独立解码确认initial==restored==restored-resample RGBA字节且next不同。交付：browser.exportFile提交1200x1200 PNG（858,996字节，SHA-256 ccad8c49827d958dda126979a3f88e9e081a0970836e0795507345bdf276e0c7）；该确切字节在客体中由固定的姊妹stdlib PNG校验器独立复验（仅作QA校验——本包不随附校验器，此复用不新增公开运行时依赖、不触发自动姊妹安装、不继承任何权限），完成全块CRC遍历、IDAT全量解压缩5,761,200字节、尺寸与摘要校验；workspace.publishOutput将其冻结为run-owned输出快照，拆除后独立读回仍逐字节一致；交付PNG、五份诊断捕获与原生导出、客体校验、发布三份回执在清理前保留。1项鉴定测试通过，无失败无跳过（197.362秒），零付费模型调用。与先前原生读回失败候选相比，归档仅assets/viewer-ui.js一个成员不同（SHA-256 c23a5794472de25b09c8f6be241b06c49b10b126c554e5a672b6f890c389e564，其2D上下文请求现声明willReadFrequently）；后处理、容差、断言与数值基准均未削弱。本审核绑定这些确切归档字节与包声明的全部授权面（12项已注册工具、5项能力）；实际执行证明链覆盖exec.shell、exec.localService、browser导航/观察/截屏/点击、browser.exportFile与workspace.publishOutput；已声明的jobs.*工具作为已注册授权面绑定，未在本次单独执行。此为基于私有302衍生鉴定源的客体加模拟器原生鉴定：browser.exportFile尚未进入任何公开App版本，App可用性取决于主线集成与主线负责的minimumAppVersion决定——目录App兼容下限仍是外部待定门槛，本文不声称任何首个可用版本。非真机或Apple发布构建验收。仅iOS渠道；无Android原生证明。无付费模型调用。对本包及其权利的审核批准与目录准入相互独立，未产生下载供给。
